scope: One process, fixed public input shapes. End-to-end covers receipt creation (run plus independent check), in-memory JSON serialization, and verification (fresh run plus check); excludes CLI process startup, filesystem/network I/O, rendering, and deallocation after each sample. p50 is median, p95 nearest rank. Full experiments are included for reproduction. Dense service quotas are zero: it is a capacity probe, not a mission achievement.

measurement_context.peak_rss_scope: Direct benchmark process across all five workloads; compiler excluded. Other scheduled host work was not excluded.
measurement_context.timing_scope: Receipt creation, invariant checks, in-memory serialization, verification and recomputation; excludes CLI startup, JSON input parsing, disk I/O, rendering, and external-agent work.
measurement_context.status: Baseline measurement; no claim of full campaign or worst-case capacity.
